title:
209 HDB flats.
*Over $1M each*

lines.say: You're selling your HDB flat. In September, 209 flats sold for over 1 million dollars. A new record.
That's about 1 in every 11 resale flats.
Most were in mature towns. Toa Payoh had 33, Queenstown 28, Bedok 20.
The top sale: a five-room flat at The Pinnacle at Duxton, for 1.72 million dollars.
We've found they tend to share a few things: a big flat, near an MRT, a long lease left and a view that stays open.
lines.cap: big flat, near *MRT*, long lease, open *view*

lines.say: But a million-dollar flat nearby doesn't mean yours is worth the same.
Most people decide this wrongly. Comment why to see the mistake.

caption:
209 HDB flats sold for over $1M in September. A new monthly record. 🏙️

That's about 1 in every 11 resale flats. Toa Payoh had 33, Queenstown 28 and Bedok 20. The top sale was a five-room flat at The Pinnacle@Duxton for $1.72M.

We've found they tend to share a few things: a big flat, near an MRT, a long lease left and an open view. But a million-dollar flat nearby doesn't mean yours is worth the same.

Most people decide this wrongly. Comment WHY to see the mistake 👇

Source: SRX, 99.co (Sept 2026). Past transactions, not a valuation.
